definitions.explanation: Traditional works of literature, music, or art from ancient times that are still valued today.
A work that has become a standard or model in its field.

notes:
{古典|こてん} refers to classical works or classics in literature, music, art, and other fields.

Common collocations:
- {古典|こてん}⟦{文学|ぶんがく}→文学：01505_bungaku⟧ (classical literature)
- {古典|こてん}⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧ (classical music)
- ⟦{古典的|こてんてき}→古典的：16845_kotenteki⟧ (classical, traditional)
- {古典|こてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (to read classics)

In Japanese education:
- {古典|こてん} as a school subject refers to classical Japanese literature (文語文), including works like ⟦{源氏物語|げんじものがたり}→源氏物語：noentry⟧ and ⟦{枕草子|まくらのそうし}→枕草子：noentry⟧.
